description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 12.09.2016 to 18.09.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters related to customs operations. It exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to establish new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges, and formally rescinds previous rates. The content focuses on regulatory compliance requirements for customs payments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
